message: Field "Post.createdAt" is optional and its value comes from @default(now()), which Prisma 8 cannot express on an optional field yet. Make the field required, or remove @default(now()) and set the value when you write documents.

Field "Post.updatedAt" is optional and its value comes from @updatedAt, which Prisma 8 cannot express on an optional field yet. Make the field required, or remove @updatedAt and set the value when you write documents.
